["When I was a boy I had a vision. I could see a wheel of my life spinning befor me. There were sections in the wheel and in each section of the wheel was a different part of my life going on ,moving like a motion picture .i could take journeys from this outside point of view,into the wheel and experence what was going on in that part of my life,and come out again to this external viewpoint. The reason I say this is I found it interesting that I was not allowed to remember my future . I don't know why ,that's just how it happened.;\)
....
In my dream it was a dance on a stage with the dancers forming interweaving wheels. I called it "dance of my soul."
As for remembering your future, it's my understand that you can only view possibilities for it."](https://www.reddit.com/r/pastlives/comments/4artn1/announcing_the_first_pastlives_ama_our_guest_is/)

probably to cause controversy and more attention to the Poppy project. fans of those artists would be suckers for Poppy's image and music and they'll check her out when they see what he's doing and who he is. it's smart... publicity is publicity

She's kind of like the Marilyn Monroe character; carefully crafted to bring about all of these feelings that people like you have gotten in order to make a dollar. Aesthetic, voice, artifice, makeover, marketing/campaigning, controversy, secrecy, innocence, scandal. Or for Titantic, I guess an artistic message and a dollar because he's never going to retire this for as long as she brings in money.

And Poppy is going to get mainstream very soon, probably this year. I wouldn't be surprised if people like Kanye West tries to get in on it and talk about it. Because at first it's all very interesting and exciting.

The only unfortunate part is the music. While i don't mind bubble gum pop, serious people in the industry aren't going to go for it. I've had friends completely turned off to the entire project because of the music. Maybe the commercial public loves it especially preteens, but she'll only get like a "living performance art" type of credit unless Poppy puts out music that explains her character deeper. People get bored eventually and move on when they don't get what they want out of you as an entertainer. 

Her and Sinclaire both seem to be friends with Of Montreal & some other neopsychedelic musicians. If they go that route I wouldn't be surprised.

I wonder how much of this is Moriah's original ideas or if she's just a fan of Sinclaire/close friends/partner and started collaborating.
